hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 223: signed batch request from Alpha Co was 23129 cents, but the refund ledger shows 23615 cents applied (difference 486 cents). Net balances would be computed from incorrect refund data, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs review of the order 223 refund before any payouts are recorded.
